name: Even or Odd
tagline: Send even numbers to the Even Block and odd numbers to the Odd Block.
brief: Send each even number to the Even Block. Send each odd number to the Odd Block.
context: Number cards arrive one at a time. Each number is either even or odd.
narrative:
Welcome to the number desk.

Number cards arrive one at a time. Your job is to put each card in the right block.

Even numbers go to the Even Block. An even number can be split into two equal halves, like 2, 4, 6 and 8.

Odd numbers go to the Odd Block. An odd number cannot be split into two equal halves, like 1, 3, 5 and 7.

The desk checks each item for you, so you do not need to do any maths. You can see the facts it gives you in the Conditions tab.
objective: Sort all sixteen numbers. Every number must end up in the right block.
learningObjective: How to use a fact about a number to choose between two blocks.
intelligenceExplanation:
Right now there are no rules. The cards wait and nothing moves.

Your task: build a rule that sends every even number to the Even Block. Then build a rule that sends every odd number to the Odd Block.

Every whole number is either even or odd. So each card belongs in exactly one block.
hint: Look in the Conditions tab for a fact that tells you whether a number is even or odd.
hints: Even numbers end in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8. Look in the Conditions tab for a fact that tells you this.
You need one rule for even numbers and one rule for odd numbers.
Answer: WHEN isEven -> DO send-to-even-block, and WHEN isOdd -> DO send-to-odd-block.
